🌺🌊 MEET MOANA! 🌊🌺
🐶 Female | 11 weeks old | Mixed Breed
This little island princess is ready to sail straight into your heart! ⛵️💕🐾
At just 11 weeks old, Moana is one super-sweet little girl with a personality that's impossible not to love. She's wonderful with people, enjoys the company of other dogs, and is ready to set off on her biggest adventure yet—finding her forever family! 🏡❤️
🌺 Super sweet
❤️ Great with people
🐶 Great with other dogs
🐱 Cats are currently unknown
